objective: Decide whether the 2.4 canary may keep serving 5% of checkout traffic

production_authorization.approver: Name of the person who approved, as they gave it
scope: send 200 synthetic checkout probes to the canary
production_authorization.blast_radius: the canary cohort (5% of traffic); synthetic accounts only
production_authorization.abort_trigger: canary 5xx rate above 2% over 200 probes, or any data write outside synthetic accounts
production_authorization.rollback: the release owner runs the documented rollback; the session does not promote or roll back

charters.title: Canary error rate against stable
charters.objective: Compare the canary's 5xx rate with stable under 200 synthetic probes
charters.oracle: Canary 5xx rate within 0.5 points of stable and below the 2% abort trigger
